items.name: theme
items.title: GetUrUI theme
items.description: Design tokens

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline alert that stays in the page flow in six tones, as a floating card or full-width banner; it unrolls with a spring, each tone icon moves once, and dismissing folds it away.

items.name: badge
items.title: Animated Badge
items.description: Small uppercase status label in nine tones, with an optional pulsing dot for live states and a lock glyph on Pro.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Animated Context Menu
items.description: Right-click or long-press menu that opens at the pointer: it scales from the nearest corner, items stagger in, a highlight glides between rows and submenus slide in beside their item.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar in six sizes with an image to initials to icon fallback chain, presence, verified and logo corners, plus a stack that fans out on hover; photos blur up into focus.

items.name: blog-cards
items.title: Blog cards
items.description: Four ways to present a post — editorial cover, compact list, featured series and author-led quote — each with its own motion moment, from layered parallax to a gliding row highlight.

items.name: blog-cards-editorial
items.title: Blog cards · Editorial
items.description: Cover card with a drawn type specimen whose layers drift under the pointer, plus category, excerpt and byline.

items.name: blog-cards-compact-list
items.title: Blog cards · Compact list
items.description: List of posts with reading-progress rings, a highlight that glides between rows and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: blog-cards-featured-split
items.title: Blog cards · Featured series
items.description: Split card for a multi-part series: step through parts while the art and copy crossfade in the direction of travel.

items.name: blog-cards-author
items.title: Blog cards · Author-led
items.description: Byline-first card with a pull quote, a bookmark that pops and ticks its count, and a copy-link action.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: Draggable glass sheet with snap points; release velocity is projected forward to pick the detent and the scrim fades with the sheet's height.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Bouncy Accordion
items.description: Single-open accordion whose panels open on a weighted height spring while the body rises out of a blur and the plus turns into a cross.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Location trail with chevron, slash or dot separators, a home crumb and long middles collapsed into a menu; in button style a hover pill glides between crumbs.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Pill button in twelve styles and five sizes with a spring press, leading and trailing icons, inline links whose underline draws in, a Spinner loading state, an async state machine and a magnetic hover.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid for a single date or a range, one or two months wide; months slide in with a blur in the direction of travel and the range band sweeps out from the start day.

items.name: card-input
items.title: Card Input
items.description: Card number, expiry and CVC in one well: digits group as you type, the brand is detected from the prefix and its mark flips in, focus advances field to field, and it stacks to two rows when narrow.

items.name: chat-bubbles
items.title: Chat bubbles
items.description: Four message threads — support with typing indicator, group chat with reactions, file and voice attachments, and delivery receipts — where every new message springs in.

items.name: chat-bubbles-support-thread
items.title: Chat bubbles · Support thread
items.description: Support conversation with grouped bubbles, quick-reply chips and a typing indicator before each answer.

items.name: chat-bubbles-group-reactions
items.title: Chat bubbles · Group reactions
items.description: Group chat with grouped senders, toggleable reaction pills whose counts roll and an inline reaction picker.

items.name: chat-bubbles-attachments
items.title: Chat bubbles · Attachments
items.description: File message with a ring-progress download and a voice note with a seekable waveform and speed control.

items.name: chat-bubbles-delivery-states
items.title: Chat bubbles · Delivery states
items.description: Direct-message thread where sent messages animate through sending, sent, delivered and read, with retry on failure.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Native checkbox whose tick draws itself with a spring, morphs to a dash when indeterminate, and groups under a select-all parent.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline numbered citation chips that open a source card with a spring on hover or focus, plus a sources list that highlights the cited item.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: AI-style code block with filename header, copy button, line numbers, line highlights and a tiny highlighter; long code collapses behind a height spring.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type-to-filter combobox: matched text lights up in volt, a create row offers what you typed, async results load behind a spinner, and an empty state wobbles in when nothing matches.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A ⌘K palette on frosted glass with fuzzy search and grouped results; a spring highlight glides to the active row as you arrow through.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Icon button that copies a value to the clipboard and morphs its glyph into a check with a scale-and-blur swap.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: CTA Banner
items.description: Large rounded call-to-action panel on a faded dot grid with a headline, two buttons and a soft volt spotlight that trails the cursor.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Date and range pickers on a sunken trigger: a popover holds the calendar, presets like Last 7 days and Apply/Cancel, plus a segmented date field whose digits roll as you step them.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Accessible base modal with a featured icon, four widths and stacked phone actions; it springs in over a blurred scrim and turns into a drag-to-dismiss bottom sheet below 640px.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock whose icons swell on springs as the cursor nears; labels rise above and the active dot glides between apps.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Donut whose arcs sweep in on springs; hovering a segment or legend row expands it and swaps the rolling centre total for that segment's share.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A side panel that springs in from the left or right over a blurred scrim; drag it toward its edge, press Escape or click outside to dismiss.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu button with button, icon, avatar or account-card triggers, an account header or filtering search, sections, checkbox and radio rows and submenus; it springs open from the trigger and a highlight glides between rows.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ
items.description: FAQ section with a heading, a spring accordion of questions and a "still have questions" contact card whose avatar stack pops in.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: Bento grid of six features where each tile runs a small live micro-animation — a typing command, a theme toggle, a moving focus ring, a rolling counter, springy bars and a clicking cursor — and lifts on hover.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, control and hint line with ids wired for screen readers; errors shake the control once and blur in under it.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: Collapsible file tree where folders spring open, chevrons rotate, indent guides light up for the active folder and a selection pill glides between rows.

items.name: footer-block
items.title: Footer
items.description: Site footer with a brand blurb, four link columns, a newsletter field that swaps to an inline success state, and a base row with legal links and a pulsing status dot.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: Horizontal funnel whose centred bars grow in stage by stage, with conversion from the top and drop-off labelled between stages.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero
items.description: Marketing hero with a pulsing announcement pill, a word-by-word headline with a volt-marked word, two CTAs, a copyable install command and a floating product shot of animated UI cards.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field on a sunken well in three sizes with a volt focus halo, leading icon, joined text, select and button add-ons, a help tooltip, a clear button and a single shake when an error appears.

items.name: integration-cards
items.title: Integration cards
items.description: App connect grid, single-integration consent and sync health cards — optimistic connect, spring permission switches and a failed sync that heals on retry.

items.name: integration-cards-connect-grid
items.title: Integration cards · Connect grid
items.description: Grid of apps with All and Connected filters, a connect flow that spins then springs to Connected, and layout-animated filtering.

items.name: integration-cards-detail
items.title: Integration cards · Integration consent
items.description: Two linked marks, a permissions list with spring switches and locked required scopes, and an authorize flow that ends in a drawn check.

items.name: integration-cards-sync-status
items.title: Integration cards · Sync status
items.description: Sync health with run-history bars, a failure notice that collapses on retry, a live record counter and an auto-sync switch.

items.name: line-charts
items.title: Line charts
items.description: Four hand-drawn SVG line charts — multi-series, single metric, period comparison and annotated steps — that reveal left to right, morph with springs and read out values on hover or arrow keys.

items.name: line-charts-multi-series
items.title: Line charts · Multi-series
items.description: Up to four series, volt first and the rest neutral or dashed; legend toggles rescale the axis with a spring morph and the crosshair reads every visible line.

items.name: line-charts-gradient-metric
items.title: Line charts · Gradient metric
items.description: One metric under a volt gradient with labelled peak and low markers, an average guide, a glowing latest point and a headline that follows the crosshair.

items.name: line-charts-period-comparison
items.title: Line charts · Period comparison
items.description: This period in solid volt against the last in dashed neutral, the gap shaded, with week, month and quarter tabs that morph both lines together.

items.name: line-charts-step-annotations
items.title: Line charts · Step with annotations
items.description: A step line for values that change in jumps, a dashed plan limit and numbered notes that pop a callout on hover or focus and step with arrow keys.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Customer logo strip of text wordmarks in varied weights and spacing, as an endless marquee or a bordered grid where each logo lifts to reveal a caption on hover.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite horizontal scroller with faded edges that loops any content, runs in either direction and pauses on hover.

items.name: masonry-gallery
items.title: Masonry Gallery
items.description: Masonry wall of tiles with mixed aspect ratios that keeps source order left to right, with category chips that filter the wall and tiles that glide into their new places.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: User and assistant chat bubbles that spring in, group consecutive messages and reveal copy, retry and feedback actions on hover or focus.

items.name: morph-label
items.title: Morph Label
items.description: A button that confirms in place: its label and icon morph through pending, done or error (Add to cart → Added → back) while the width springs to fit, plus a SwapSlot for any value that changes.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Number field with steppers on both sides or stacked on the right, min/max/step, full keyboard control and press-and-hold that speeds up; digits roll to each new value on a spring.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Odometer Number
items.description: Number that rolls each digit on its own spring reel, staggered left to right, when it scrolls into view or the value changes.

items.name: morphing-modal
items.title: Origin Modal
items.description: A multi-view modal that opens from the button that launched it and returns there on close; the panel height springs between views and content crossfades through a blur.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time-code field where a focus ring glides between slots and digits roll in; wrong codes shake, right ones draw a check.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pure page-window engine plus numbered, compact, card-footer and carousel-dot paginators; the volt marker glides to the active page and numbers slide as the window shifts.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with an eye toggle that blinks and draws its slash, a four-segment strength meter that springs in, and an optional requirements checklist.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Click-to-open panel anchored to its trigger that scales from the trigger edge with a spring and flips above or below to stay in the viewport.

items.name: pricing-section
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Pricing table with a volt billing toggle, a seat slider with volume-discount tiers and plan prices that roll digit by digit whenever billing or seats change; the featured plan glows.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Chat composer with an auto-growing textarea, model picker and attachment chips; the send button morphs into a stop button while a reply streams.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Single-choice group with roving focus and a selected dot that glides between options on a spring; card mode turns options into tiles a volt ring slides across.

items.name: range-slider
items.title: Range Slider
items.description: Slider with a volt fill, step ticks and a bar-shaped thumb that springs to each step and stretches while you drag.

items.name: review-cards
items.title: Review cards
items.description: Five review cards — rating summary, standout quote, review composer, compact list and photo review — with count-ups, star pops, rolling vote counts and a shared-element photo viewer.

items.name: review-cards-summary
items.title: Review cards · Rating summary
items.description: Average that counts up over a star histogram whose bars grow in and filter the list.

items.name: review-cards-quote
items.title: Review cards · Standout quote
items.description: Single verified review with popping stars, a body that springs open with Read more, and a helpful toggle.

items.name: review-cards-write
items.title: Review cards · Write a review
items.description: Star radio group with hover preview and spring pop, quick tags, counted text box and a thank-you crossfade.

items.name: review-cards-compact
items.title: Review cards · Compact list
items.description: Dense rows with star lines and optimistic helpful votes whose counts roll.

items.name: review-cards-photos
items.title: Review cards · Photo review
items.description: Review with a drawn photo strip; a thumbnail grows into an in-card viewer with arrow keys and Escape.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-choice select on the field well with avatars, status dots, icons, groups and an optional search box; a volt highlight glides between options and the panel springs open, flipping above near the viewport edge.

items.name: composition-chart
items.title: Share of Total Chart
items.description: 100% stacked bars or areas showing each series' share per period; toggling between them re-stacks with springs, with a period tooltip and a legend that hides series.

items.name: sign-up-form
items.title: Sign Up Form
items.description: Sign-up card with a GitHub button, an email field that validates and shakes, an animated password-strength meter, a stateful submit and a success state that morphs in with a drawn check.

items.name: social-posts
items.title: Social posts
items.description: Four feed posts — text, photo grid, poll and link preview — with optimistic toggles, rolling counts, a shared-layout photo viewer and results that count up.

items.name: social-posts-text-post
items.title: Social posts · Text post
items.description: Text post with optimistic like, repost and bookmark: icons pop, the like bursts and counts roll.

items.name: social-posts-image-grid
items.title: Social posts · Photo grid
items.description: Photo post whose drawn grid tiles expand into a viewer with a shared-layout morph, arrow paging and Escape to close.

items.name: social-posts-poll
items.title: Social posts · Poll
items.description: Poll post where voting grows the result bars and counts percentages up, with your choice marked and undo.

items.name: social-posts-link-preview
items.title: Social posts · Link preview
items.description: Post with an expandable body and a rich link preview whose drawn image drifts on hover, plus like and copy link.

items.name: sparkline-stats
items.title: Sparkline Stats
items.description: KPI cards with rolling numbers, an up/down delta badge and a sparkline that draws in, with a crosshair on hover or arrow keys.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator as a ring, dots or equaliser bars in five sizes; it announces itself as a status and slows to a pulse for reduced motion.

items.name: stat-cards
items.title: Stat cards
items.description: Four metric cards — headline KPI, scrubbable sparkline, goal ring and two-period comparison — with count-ups, redrawn lines, springing arcs and bars.

items.name: stat-cards-kpi
items.title: Stat cards · KPI
items.description: Headline figure that counts up with its delta, and a breakdown that springs open into a stacked bar.

items.name: stat-cards-sparkline
items.title: Stat cards · Sparkline
items.description: Period tabs redraw the line; pointer or arrow keys scrub to any point and the figure crossfades.

items.name: stat-cards-goal
items.title: Stat cards · Goal ring
items.description: Progress ring and percentage spring to each logged step; milestones tick and the goal swaps to a done state.

items.name: stat-cards-comparison
items.title: Stat cards · Comparison
items.description: Metric tabs swap two period bars that spring to new lengths while the delta crossfades.

items.name: stats-section
items.title: Stats
items.description: Four headline numbers that roll in digit by digit, each with a sparkline that draws itself, fills its area and drops an end dot when scrolled into view.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress steps, horizontal or vertical, with number, icon, dot or bar markers; connectors fill with a spring, numbers morph into drawn checks and the current step breathes.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle switch whose thumb slides on a stiff spring and stretches while pressed.

items.name: switch-cards
items.title: Switch cards
items.description: Three settings cards built on a springy switch — notification preferences with a saved cue, plan features with dependent options and a save bar, and privacy toggles that ask before turning protection off.

items.name: switch-cards-notifications
items.title: Switch cards · Notifications
items.description: Email and push preferences in labelled groups; the thumb stretches on press and a Saved chip blurs in after each change.

items.name: switch-cards-plan-features
items.title: Switch cards · Plan features
items.description: Workspace feature toggles where child options unlock with their parent, a locked row names its plan, and a save bar springs in once anything changes.

items.name: switch-cards-privacy
items.title: Switch cards · Privacy
items.description: Privacy and security switches with a Protected or At risk badge; turning off a sensitive one opens an inline confirmation first.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented tabs in pill, volt and underline styles; a shared spring indicator glides to the active tab and resizes to fit it.

items.name: tag-group
items.title: Tag group
items.description: Chips with dots, avatars, flags, icons, counts and remove buttons, selectable singly or in sets; a removed chip blurs out while its neighbours slide closed.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Text field that turns entries into chips on Enter, comma or paste, validates each one, and springs new chips in while removed ones slide out.

items.name: tag-select
items.title: Tag select
items.description: Multi-select whose picks become chips in the field: chips pop in with a spring and fold into “+N”, options tick a drawn checkbox, arrows walk the chips and Backspace removes them, with Reset and Select all in the footer.

items.name: testimonials-wall
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Wall of quote cards with initials avatars: two marquee rows drifting in opposite directions, or a masonry layout whose cards blur up into view.

items.name: text-animation
items.title: Text Animation
items.description: Four text effects: a word-by-word blur reveal with a volt underline, a shimmer sweep, a glyph scramble and a rotating word swap.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line field on the sunken well that grows with a spring between min and max rows, with a ring-gauge character counter, a resize handle and a toolbar slot.

items.name: theme-switchers
items.title: Theme switchers
items.description: Three appearance controls — a light/dark/system segmented switch with a sliding thumb, an appearance card with live mini previews, and an accent and density picker — that report changes without touching your site.

items.name: theme-switchers-segmented
items.title: Theme switchers · Segmented
items.description: Light, dark and system options with a thumb that slides between them and an icon that turns as it lands; text or icon-only.

items.name: theme-switchers-appearance-card
items.title: Theme switchers · Appearance card
items.description: Theme cards with tiny app windows drawn in each theme's real tokens, a check that pops onto the chosen one and a stepped text-size slider.

items.name: theme-switchers-accent-density
items.title: Theme switchers · Accent and density
items.description: Accent swatches and a density control beside a live preview whose rows re-space with a layout spring and repaint in the chosen accent.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A sun/moon button that flips the whole page between dark and light with a View Transition reveal from the button, as a circle or staggered slats.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer on a spring, with a glare that tracks the cursor and layers that float at different depths.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toasts
items.description: Imperative toasts that stack in the corner, fan out on hover, update in place from loading to done, and blur away on dismiss.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Token Stream
items.description: Renders an AI reply token by token from a string or async stream, fading each chunk in behind a blinking caret, with safe markdown.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus label rendered in a portal: it scales in from its trigger on a soft spring, flips to the side with room, carries a title, description, arrow and shortcut, and hands off instantly between neighbours.

items.name: user-menus
items.title: User menus
items.description: Three account menus — an avatar dropdown with workspace switcher and theme row, a sidebar footer menu that opens upward, and a searchable command-style profile menu — each springing from its trigger.

items.name: user-menus-avatar-dropdown
items.title: User menus · Avatar dropdown
items.description: Top-bar avatar menu with a workspace switcher whose check glides between rows, a light/dark/system row and shortcut hints.

items.name: user-menus-sidebar-footer
items.title: User menus · Sidebar footer
items.description: User button for the bottom of a sidebar; the menu opens upward with a seat meter, and ArrowUp opens it on the last item.

items.name: user-menus-command-profile
items.title: User menus · Command profile
items.description: Profile menu with a search field: type to filter grouped actions, a highlight slides between rows and every action shows its shortcut.

items.name: welcome-cards
items.title: Welcome cards
items.description: Three dashboard welcome cards — today at a glance, onboarding checklist and what’s new — with staggered count-ups, one-at-a-time steps and a swipeable release carousel.

items.name: welcome-cards-today
items.title: Welcome cards · Today
items.description: Time-aware greeting, today’s numbers counting up in a stagger and an up-next strip you can step through.

items.name: welcome-cards-onboarding
items.title: Welcome cards · Onboarding checklist
items.description: One step open at a time; completing a step ticks, fills its segment and advances, then the card celebrates.

items.name: welcome-cards-whats-new
items.title: Welcome cards · What’s new
items.description: Swipeable release carousel with drawn art; a Pro feature turns the button into an ember upgrade.
